text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: *wheeze*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin!
A magnificent triumph in the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it, this thunderous cheer! The massive applause praising this year's Derby Umamusume!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hah... Ahaha...!
I did it... I really did it...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Me, a Derby Umamusume...!
Aha, ahaha...!

text_block_list.name: False-Eyelash Gal
text_block_list.text: Whoa... You really are amazing, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text:
Man, look at her...
She's completely exhausted. ...And yet.

text_block_list.name: Part-Time Gal
text_block_list.text: Why does this look so cool...!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: Big siiis! That was the best!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (UWAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, hehe... what should I do...?!
...All these cheers belong to me and me alone...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay for me to have this...!
Such a wonderful moment...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...I have to go.
Everyone's applauding for me.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Quickly, to the winner's circle...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah. Ahaha. No good,
it's taking everything I have just to stand up."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Even though I have to go.
Even though I have to live up to their hopes...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer...?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Aha... Looks like I can't walk for a bit.
Go on ahead and tell everyone thank you for me.
choice_data_list: I'm not staying behind—I'm going with you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Come on, don't make this difficult.
At least you go out there and answer them.
As my Trainer, go face everyone..."
choice_data_list: Because everyone is waiting for you too!
Because everyone is waiting for you too!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
—...Nes, ...Nes!
I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I-NES! I-NES!!
I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. Ahaha. I'm not even
in the Winner's Circle yet, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Even so... are you all planning
to keep chanting until I show up...?
choice_data_list: That's how moved everyone was by your run.
That's how deeply moved I was by your run.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...! Haha... Oh, come on...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Then can we take it slow?
If so, I think I can head over...
choice_data_list: Yeah, I'll lend you a shoulder too.
Yeah, I can lend you a shoulder too.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu, thanks a bunch~
I'm gonna lean all my weight on you!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(—Honestly, I really couldn't walk, you know?
I gave absolutely everything I had in that race.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
(Because it was my dream.
To run with everything I had across the turf,
wrapped in roaring cheers.)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (Finishing in 1st place in the Derby is...)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: (...But hearing everyone's voices...)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
I-NES! I-NES!!
I-NES! I-NES!!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Hearing cheers like this makes me want to answer them.
It really gives me energy."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ......Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Thank you, everyone--!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOAAAAAAAHHH!!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: ...Congratulations, Ines.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: "Still, the journey along the Triple Crown road continues... Next time, with her in the race as well."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Even so, the Kikuka Sho... I will definitely win it...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The spectators and Umamusume, each carrying their own excitement.
This day's live performance continued to radiate an extraordinary fervor until the final light faded.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if reluctant to part with the Derby—the culmination of a singular dream.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As if blessing the future of the Umamusume who have crossed a single milestone.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And when I rushed over to Ines Fujin,
who had sung her heart out as the live concert's center...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer.
Did I manage to sing well all the way to the end of the concert?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I wonder if I was able to convey my gratitude to everyone for all the cheers they just gave me?
choice_data_list: Yeah, that was a wonderful concert!
Yeah, that was a fantastic live performance!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's... good... then...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Flump...!)

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: ...What a relief...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Ines Fujin collapsed
onto the cold hallway floor.
